from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial record for a single company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if available")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period string, e.g. '2025 Q1'")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating revenue amount for the period")
    cash_received_from_sales: float | None = Field(description="Cash received from sales of goods and services")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'CNY' or 'Yuan'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted financial records from the document collection."""
    company_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
